translations.en_EN:
This Week in Star Citizen xē'suelen nyahyan, hello everyone,
Last week, Alpha 4.10.3 opened to all waves in the PTU as we continued preparing for its upcoming release. As Vanduul attacks escalate across Nyx, the new InterSec Defense Solutions missions will put your combat skills to the test! We want to extend a huge thank you to everyone who jumped into the PTU over the weekend to help our teams test the latest update. We’re now reviewing the data and your reports as we work through the final improvements ahead of release. If you haven’t already, check out the latest PTU Patch Notes and share your thoughts in the dedicated feedback threads for Vanduul Incursion and the new Skarnov Rifle.

Following our recent announcement about updates to Pledge Gifting and Game Access, we also published a Pledge Gifting FAQ. These changes took effect on October 30, and we’ve gathered answers to some of your most frequently asked questions, along with additional clarification to help you better understand what’s changed and how it may affect your account.

Subscribers also received the October 2026 issue of Jump Point, taking you behind the scenes of RSI’s latest additions to the 'verse: the Constellation Mk V Centaurus and its smaller companion, the Skylark. If you're a Subscriber, grab your copy from the Subscriber section of your account.

Now let's see what's going on this week:
On Tuesday, Subscribers can look forward to the November Subscriber Comm-Link and Newsletter, bringing the latest exclusive flairs for the month ahead.

On Wednesday, the October 2026 PU Monthly Report will offer a look at what our teams have been working on over the past month, from gameplay and technology, to ships, art, and more. We’ll also publish a Roadmap Update and a Roadmap Roundup as we continue charting the course for upcoming releases.

Finally, on Friday, the latest RSI Weekly Newsletter also lands in your inbox. If you're not subscribed yet, you can sign up at any time through your account settings.

And looking a little further ahead, not this weekend, but the next, members of our team will be heading to Barcelona, Spain, for a Bar Citizen on Saturday, November 14! This will be the final stop on our Bar Citizen World Tour 2026, and we can't wait to wrap up an incredible year of community gatherings with you there!

a.thl’ē’kol, see you soon.

Senior Community Manager Lénaïc "Nicou" Riédinger The Weekly Community Content Schedule

Point is, no damn AI system's ever gonna be as good as an experienced Chief engineer

Known locally as The Hive, this High-pressure Coreless Planet is situated on the further edge of the green band and is often overlooked when compared to Kilian XIII "Maybe you should have a Engineer have a look at you. Be sure." said Hester Polaris A further investigation of the planet revealed a cache of Kr'Thak weapons and war machines. "We don't have anythCore." Ernst said. The Being didn't like that answer.
